sources.entry: Kimi Membership – official paid membership page with multiple tiers

summary.name: Kimi Membership
summary.one_liner: Kimi Membership is the paid subscription page for Moonshot AI's Kimi assistant, offering Plus, Pro, Max and Ultra tiers with more agent credits, faster models and research preview features.
use_cases: Comparing Kimi subscription tiers before paying
Running deep research and financial analysis with an AI agent
Building and deploying websites with an AI agent
Working on coding projects with Kimi Code
Automating recurring tasks with scheduled agent runs
Creating documents, spreadsheets and slides with AI
summary.what_it_does: The page lists four paid Kimi Membership tiers: Plus ($15/month, or $19 listed; billed annually at $180), Pro ($31/month, billed annually $372), Max ($79/month, billed annually $948) and Ultra ($159/month, billed annually $1,908). Higher tiers add more agent credits (Plus base, Pro 2x, Max 5x, Ultra 10x), access to K3.1 Pro Highspeed, up to 1M tokens of context, one-click Kimi Claw deployment and goal mode. All tiers include document, spreadsheet and slide work, Deep Research, website deployment with database support, agent multi-tasking, Kimi Code, a dashboard with task widgets, scheduled tasks that push results, Swarm multi-agent features and plugins for financial and economic databases. The page also has a FAQ about locating benefits after subscribing, getting invoices and upgrading plans.
notable: Four tiers (Plus, Pro, Max, Ultra) with increasing agent credits and K3.1 Pro Highspeed access on higher plans
Swarm multi-agent mode and goal mode where agents work autonomously until completion
Plugins for professional financial and economic databases
Build and publish websites with database support
caveats: Purchase notice says K3.1 Pro requests may queue or fail at launch, with wait times depending on load
Prices shown are monthly with annual billing; Plus lists $15/month alongside a $19 figure, which the page does not explain
Several features (such as Deep Research and the Swarm mode) are labeled as research preview
